operating_contract.autonomy: Proceed autonomously through technically resolvable rights/source qualification, provenance/attribution classification, bounded measurement, protected prewrite, implementation, ordinary CI/deployment and source-audit work. Stop at genuine human/security/cost/source-rights/topology/unrecoverable blockers, owner-authenticated production-write gates, or continuation boundaries.
operating_contract.rights: Fail closed. Private runtime creates no reuse permission. Unknown or materially unresolved rights are held or rejected. Every admitted cohort must carry exact provenance plus attribution/disclosure classification.
operating_contract.storage: Protected recipe bodies remain in private Cloudflare D1. GitHub contains only public code and public-safe evidence/artifacts. Browser-direct protected database access is forbidden.
operating_contract.authentication: Every protected request remains server-side authenticated and authorized through the application-owned identity verifier, exact allowlist and secure session. Do not weaken or emulate the owner authentication gate.
operating_contract.billing_firewall: No paid infrastructure, billing enablement or automatic overage authorization.
operating_contract.topology: Exactly two protected recipe-body D1 shards. No third shard is authorized.
operating_contract.d1_budget: v8014 preserves the existing maximum of 16/16 D1 subqueries with zero assumed headroom.
operating_contract.public_activation: Public runtime remains 85 recipes and broader public corpus/recommendation activation is not authorized.
operating_contract.source_authority: Historical provenance is not authority for cultural authenticity, nutrition, allergens, dietary classification, scaling or medical claims.
